scenes.vo: A wallet can build years of perfect repayment history on Ethereum, and still arrive on any other chain as a complete stranger.

expect.visible: text=The floor. No history on this chain.

scenes.vo: Moving that record is the easy half. Making it trustworthy is the hard half — a signature proves key control, a bridge asks you to trust a committee, and an oracle puts back the middleman you were removing.
So Hana imports the record and has Creditcoin verify it on chain — a Merkle inclusion proof checked by the Attestcoin precompile. The result is one public view call that any contract can read.

And a registry only one app reads is just plumbing. So there are two, deliberately different — retail buy-now-pay-later, and a DePIN node operator credit line — on the same score, with no coupling between them.
